# Shades of Silence

> > A creative writing blog by Kenny exploring worldbuilding techniques, fantasy writing, and reflections on life's quieter moments.

This site features the Worldbuilding Series with practical resources for fantasy writers, covering topics from mapmaking and geography to heraldry and city-building. Kenny (@konstructorkenny) curates tools like World Anvil, Probable Train City Generator, and the Book of Traceable Heraldic Art to help creators build immersive fictional worlds.
